scope: Opt-in private hosted inbound files for signed Slack agent thread messages. Broader gateway and both catalog aliases remain partial.
implemented: Optional explicit capture_slack_files requires Slack agent threads and a matching enabled fixed-channel account connection; no outgoing-send action required.
Signed ordinary/file_share messages acknowledge durable receipt with only one to five distinct file IDs and pinned connection revision; provider event URLs are discarded.
Existing event worker claims under native workspace/SQL lock and releases lock during bounded HTTP. Capture and launch use versioned states, preserving ordering and duplicate suppression.

Actual files.info plus original-byte downloads validate identity, selected-channel shares, hosted/non-external mode, name and exact size. Only canonical private HTTPS files.slack.com/files-pri/ URLs; no redirects, proxies or retries.

Private native artifact storage and expected immutable revisions feed the ordinary agent attachment path. Empty file-only messages get a default inspection task. Text model execution and PNG capture are verified; vision providers are separate.

Entry, connection, identity and project revocation are checked before capture/save/dispatch. Recovery fences stale claims; interrupted fetching/launching becomes uncertain and is never automatically replayed.
File/SQLite restart and stopped backup/restore retain manifest, private bytes and references; restored gateways remain disabled.
Responsive opt-in setup saves/reopens and explains selected-provider transfer. Existing service worker cache advances to v59.

simulation.scope: Final successful four-test HTTP/SDK run only. Full log also retains earlier fixture/debug runs. Lost-response direct peer is separate.

validation.privacy: Shared-mode checks resolve Alice credentials, save Alice-owned artifacts, reject Bob downloads/revisions and stop pending dispatch after project revocation.

browser.save_reopen: Disabled synthetic entrypoint saved capture true to false to true, remained disabled, reopened at revision 3. Checkbox disables without threads and hides outside Slack. Tab moves to next checkbox.

validation.static: Affected Python lint, newly changed focused file formatting, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace pass. Unrelated existing messaging formatting is preserved.

completion_claims.scope: Recorded-claim consistency only; this command does not run acceptance tests or certify runtime behavior.

limits.provider_formats: Existing CLI/API attachment and vision limitations apply; no provider fallback.

migration.records: Additive manifest, claim nonce and native artifact references in existing channel-events; no new collection/auth/scheduler/store.
migration.compatibility: Earlier readers ignore these versioned pending states. Pause opted-in entrypoints before downgrade or mixed-version deployment because older readers do not understand fresh incoming file events. Retain all receipt/session/artifact metadata.
migration.recovery: Interrupted fetching/launching is uncertain; stale workers cannot save or overwrite recovered state. Review Activity/private files before explicitly saving a new entrypoint revision and sending a fresh message. No automatic replay.
migration.partial_failure: All downloads finish before saving. A storage interruption may leave private inspectable artifacts; no run starts until complete capture and expected-revision preflight.

remaining: Outbound Slack artifact transfer/downloads and richer artifact replies.
Workflow threads/files, Slack feedback/evaluations, cancellation and help/artifact interactions.
Verified Socket Mode transport and independent catalog invocation/source reviews.
Milestone 8 operations and standalone desktop delivery; desktop remains last.
live_validation_pending: Real Slack files:read scopes, selected channel shares/permissions and actual workspace delivery.
Real provider vision execution, physical devices and personal HTTPS VM.

discovery.fit: Partial: metadata/auth/scopes provided; original-byte download omitted. Official file-object documentation supplies download contract.
discovery.owner_mock: Existing hosted discovery unavailable while signed out. Existing local Slack simulation extended from public contracts; no external workspace binding/publication.
